items.text: Nvidia's board unanimously reinstated Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director on Monday, Nov 23, and the shares surged 31.48% that day, adding about $950 billion in market value.

reels.topic: Huang reinstated, Nvidia's best day since 2003
reels.hook: Nvidia brought Jensen Huang back. The stock jumped 31%.
reels.why: Reinstating Huang 11 days after he resigned added about $950 billion to Nvidia in one day and pulled the whole market out of its slump.

reels.hook: StoneX upgraded Nvidia, and cut its target by $65.
reels.why: A wave of upgrades followed Huang's return, but several targets sit below where they were before he left.

reels.hook: Huang is back. The DOJ and SEC probes aren't gone.
reels.why: Huang faces a closed-door House interview next week while chip-smuggling investigations continue.

reels.topic: Hot core PCE and a near-certain Fed hike
reels.hook: Core inflation hit 3.3%. A December hike is 93% priced.
reels.why: Hotter-than-forecast core PCE kept a December rate hike nearly locked in, a headwind for tech valuations.

reels.topic: Record Thanksgiving online spending lifts Amazon
reels.hook: Americans spent $7.1 billion online on Thanksgiving.
reels.why: Adobe's record holiday numbers sent Amazon higher on Black Friday.
